title_en: Fall 2026 Graduation Project Session 1 Special Lecture: Overview of Thesis Writing
summary: Students currently taking the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in Fall 2026 must attend Session 1, the special lecture "Overview of Thesis Writing," on Friday, September 11 at 18:30 in Building 301, Room 102. Attendance is checked at 18:30, and absences or late arrivals lower the grade or result in an F. Undergraduates who plan to take the Graduation Project in the future may audit and must enter before 19:00.
applies_to: Mandatory for students currently taking the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in Fall 2026. It is especially recommended for third- and fourth-year undergraduates who will soon need to write a graduation thesis.

translation:
[Fall 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Session 1 Special Lecture: "Overview of Thesis Writing"

We announce Session 1 of the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project), a special lecture titled "Overview of Thesis Writing."

The lecture slides are also attached. Please download and use them if you need them.

This special lecture is for students currently taking the Graduation Project.

Because the topic concerns thesis writing, auditing [청강] will be open, without restriction, to undergraduates who plan to take the Graduation Project in the future.

In particular, third- and fourth-year undergraduates who will soon need to write a graduation thesis are recommended to attend.

• Lecture title: Overview of Thesis Writing
• Lecturer: a professor (the name is given in the original notice)
• Date and time: Friday, September 11, 18:30
• Location: Building 301, Room 102

※ Students taking the course will receive an F if they miss (or arrive late to) two sessions, so you must attend. (1 absence: one-step grade deduction, A+ → A0; 2 absences: F.)
※ Attendance is checked at 18:30.
※ Every year some students fail to earn the credit because of attendance problems, so please take care.

* Because of the nature of the lecture, entry from 19:00 may be restricted. Those who wish to audit, please enter before 19:00.
Since some students take this lecture as part of the regular course, there may be additional instructions for auditors.

Attachment (1)
SNU 전기∙정보공학부 특강(장이분교수님)_20260911.pptx (3 MB). The content of this attachment was not read.
